texts: In physiologic biventricular repair, pulmonary valve stenosis is managed by valvotomy when there is no annular hypoplasia: B.
Subvalvular or annular obstruction is usually bypassed with a conduit from the left ventricle to the pulmonary artery, because the conduction bundle runs close by and resection risks heart block.
Ventriculotomy in the systemic (morphological right) ventricle is avoided, outflow patches are not routine, and VSD stitches are placed on the morphological right side of the septum.
In the picture, the scissors open the door because its collar is a normal size, and nobody carves the funnel's wall.
Memory hook: a normal collar, a simple snip.
